#   GPU=1 SHARD=1 bash step1_generate_candidates.sh
#   GPU=2 SHARD=2 bash step1_generate_candidates.sh
#   GPU=3 SHARD=3 bash step1_generate_candidates.sh

#   GPU=0 bash step1_generate_candidates.sh
set -e

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${GPU:-${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0}}
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
cd /root/autodl-tmp

SHARD_ID=${SHARD:-none}
NUM_SHARDS=${NUM_SHARDS:-4}

BASE_MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-4B
SFT_ADAPTER=/root/autodl-tmp/sft_output_seed44
DATA_PATH=/root/autodl-tmp/data/docred
OUTPUT_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/rsft_generations_4b_sft_s44

SHARD_ARGS=""
if [ "$SHARD_ID" != "none" ]; then
    SHARD_ARGS="--shard_id $SHARD_ID --num_shards $NUM_SHARDS"
    echo "=== D112 Step1: shard $SHARD_ID/$NUM_SHARDS on GPU $CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES ==="
else

fi

  --sft_adapter "$SFT_ADAPTER" \
  --data_path "$DATA_PATH" \

  --output_dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
  --num_generations 8 \
  --temperature 0.7 \
  --top_p 0.95 \
  --batch_size 1 \
  --max_new_tokens 1024 \
  --seed 42 \
  $SHARD_ARGS

echo "=== D112 Step1 complete. Output: $OUTPUT_DIR ==="
